tasks.subject: Task 0: Schema migration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Apply database schema changes for stocktake redesign — new columns on existing tables, new variance reason table, seeded defaults.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/patches/stocktake_redesign_schema.sql`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Migration SQL runs without error on a fresh schema
- [ ] `stocktake_session` has `reference_number`, `session_type`, `notes`, `blind_count`, `approved_by`, `approved_at`
- [ ] `stocktake_line` has `notes`, `counted_by`, `counted_at`, `variance_reason_id`
- [ ] `stocktake_variance_reason` table created with tenant_id, name, sort_order
- [ ] 6 default reasons seeded for all existing tenants
- [ ] `component` has `bin_sub_location`, `bin_row`, `bin_bay`
- [ ] Status check constraint extended with new statuses

**Verify:** Apply SQL to local Supabase; confirm columns appear in table inspector

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/patches/stocktake_redesign_schema.sql"], "verifyCommand": "supabase db reset", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Migration runs without error", "All new columns present", "stocktake_variance_reason table created", "6 default reasons seeded for existing tenants", "component has bin location columns"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Lifecycle update
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Update `lifecycle.ts` with new statuses and transition helpers; update tests.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/lib/stocktake/lifecycle.ts`
- Modify: `src/lib/stocktake/lifecycle.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `StocktakeStatus` type includes `'counting' | 'reconciliation'`
- [ ] `canSubmitForReview(status)` returns true only for `'counting'`
- [ ] `canApprove(status)` returns true only for `'reconciliation'`
- [ ] `canSendBackForRecount(status)` returns true only for `'reconciliation'`
- [ ] `isCountingStatus(status)` returns true for `'counting'` and `'open'`
- [ ] `canEditStocktakeLines` returns true for `'counting'` and `'open'`
- [ ] `canApplyStocktakeSession` still requires `'approved'`
- [ ] All tests pass: `npm test -- lifecycle`

**Verify:** `npm test -- lifecycle` → all green

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/stocktake/lifecycle.ts", "src/lib/stocktake/lifecycle.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- lifecycle", "acceptanceCriteria": ["StocktakeStatus includes counting and reconciliation", "canSubmitForReview returns true for counting only", "canApprove returns true for reconciliation only", "canSendBackForRecount returns true for reconciliation only", "isCountingStatus returns true for counting and open", "canEditStocktakeLines returns true for counting and open", "All tests pass"]}
```
